peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 7.6% above its local comparables; 38 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (87.3): 6.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 44 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 70.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $881,944 ($2,101 psf, 419 sq ft; 6 resales, May 2023–Apr 2025); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,902 psf (range $1,746–2,230); 10.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $84,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,398,888 ($2,133 psf, 570–721 sq ft; 13 resales, Feb 2024–Jan 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,904 psf (range $1,849–2,140); 12% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $150,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $2,080,000 ($2,210 psf, 936–1,033 sq ft; 5 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $2,203 psf (range $1,822–2,991); 0.3% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $7,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Farrer Park MRT about 350 m, Bendemeer MRT about 460 m; closer than 14 of 51 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Farrer Park Primary School about 920 m; more than 24 of 51 similar developments (the same as 23). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 11 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 310 m), more than 49 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1); nearest hawker centre Berseh Food Centre about 670 m; nearest park Kallang Riverside Park about 860 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 790 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,270 m; Aurea, 39 new sales, about 1,330 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,430 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,620 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,690 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,790 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 1,850 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 271 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 125 new sales and 807 resales (932 purchases); new sales were 13.4% of these purchases. Subsales (44) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 807 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 37 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 807 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 839 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−3.8%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
